messages:
alexa: Quick FYI  Partner marketplace pre-listing review found a missing KMS attestation and a clarifying question on our pen-test scope. They want to know if third-party integrations (SI connectors) were in scope for the pen-test.
sarah: If by SI connectors they mean SAML/SCIM onboarding endpoints, those were included in the internal scan but not the external pen-test vendor scope. We should state that explicitly and offer a targeted re-test if required.
parth: Agree. That will impact timeline and cost for partner. Put that in the cover note.
mike: I'll assemble an addendum describing scope boundaries. Also will attach SAML metadata and IDP contact list.
security-bot: Auto: Created artifact KMS-attest-2025.pdf in s3://redwood-security/evidence/KMS-attest-2025.pdf. Presign default TTL=72h.
alexa: Partner wants an attestation that we can use HSM-backed keys for private deployments. Do we have a short attestation note or screenshot to include?
sarah: We do. Adding note: "HSM-backed keys are used for private deployments where required; for hosted we use provider KMS with HSM protections as indicated by provider."
parth: Let's keep the artifact package minimal: redacted SOC, pen-test exec summary, KMS attestation, scope addendum, and a short data retention excerpt. No raw POCs.
mike: Uploaded presigned links (placeholders):
- KMS attestation: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-security/KMS-attest-2025.pdf?sig=111
- Scope addendum: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-security/pen-scope-addendum.pdf?sig=222
- Pen-test exec summary: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-security/pen-summary-1p.pdf?sig=333
sarah: I'll prep the cover email and redaction notes. Legal review pending.
alexa: Great. I'll brief partner on the call tomorrow and ask if they need the full vendor report under NDA.
